descriptions.w3d_d31e_dump_object_801b25e8: Writes a readable dump of an object to the dumper's stream: a local formatting writer on the output at +40 prints the class name and address, then, walking the class chain from root to leaf, prints each property: array properties as name, count and elements (recursing for object elements, or through 0x801ef970 for plain ones), others as name = value (recursing for object values), with indent and closing lines. Takes the interface pointer (object at -4). Names are inferred.
